name: @cheezmil/aek-for-dsh
description: DSh bundle: installing @cheezmil/aek-for-dsh into a dsh profile gives the profile the dsh-facing AEK plugins (coraek, aek-websearch, aek-prompt-manager). Host-specific UI surfaces like aek-home are intentionally not included — wire them in the host that owns them.

aek.description: DSh bundle: install once to give the profile access to all AEK plugins
